chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about zakat al-fitrah, so he said:
The neighbors have the greatest right to it, and there is no harm in giving its equivalent value in silver.

key_terms.الْجِيرَانُ: neighbors, identified here as having priority in receiving it
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: zakat al-fitrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.فِضَّةً: silver, meaning monetary payment in silver value

ai.seo_question: Can zakat al-fitrah be given as money, and who has priority in receiving it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding zakat al-fitrah, stating that neighbors are more entitled to receive it. It also permits giving its equivalent monetary value in silver instead of the original food form.
